summary: Iteration 42 — Campaign/drip export, import, convert-to-drip + RichTextEditor delete-image-toolbar + spellcheck. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_42_export_import_convert.py — 18 pytest cases — ALL 18 PASS. Backend verified: (1) GET /api/campaigns/{id}/export returns 200 application/json with schema_version=1, type='campaign', and the full campaign{} object containing name/subject/body/body_text/from_name/list_name/account_emails/dne_list_names/send_range_*/scheduled_at/schedule_timezone/add_unsubscribe_footer/tracking_opens/tracking_clicks/created_at; operational fields (recipient_progress, sent_logs, analytics, replies, _id) absent. (2) POST /api/campaigns/import accepts the export payload, creates a draft campaign — name collision adds ' (Imported)' then ' (Imported 2)' on next collision (verified 2 imports of same payload → 2 distinct campaign_ids with distinct names). Returns {campaign_id,name,status:'draft',list_matched,accounts_matched,dne_lists_matched}. Rejects type='drip_campaign' with 400. (3) POST /api/campaigns/{id}/convert-to-drip creates drip with one step carrying subject/body, returns {drip_id,name,status:'draft',source_campaign_id}; verified source campaign UNCHANGED (name/subject/body/status/from_name identical before & after). New drip status='draft', steps length=1, subject/body/from_name copied from source. (4) GET /api/drip-campaigns/{id}/export returns drip{} with name/from_name/list_name/account_emails/dne_list_names/steps[...]/schedule/stop_on_reply/stop_on_bounce/tracking_*/add_unsubscribe_footer/created_at; each step has delay_days+delay_hours; operational fields absent. (5) POST /api/drip-campaigns/import: 2 imports of same payload → 2 distinct drips with unique-name suffix; zero-step payload returns 400; wrong type returns 400. (6) Anonymous (no cookie) requests to all 5 endpoints return 401. (7) Regression smoke 200 on /api/campaigns, /api/drip-campaigns, /api/campaigns/{id}/duplicate, /api/drip-campaigns/{id}/duplicate. Frontend Playwright verified: campaign-import-btn + campaign-import-file-input present in /campaign header; export-campaign-{id} + convert-to-drip-{id} testids present on every row (14/14); drip-import-btn + drip-import-file-input present in /drip-campaigns header; drip-export-{id} testid on every drip card (4/4); convert-to-drip flow navigates to /drip-campaigns/{new_id} and the source campaign still appears in the campaigns list with its original testid intact; RichTextEditor contentEditable has spellCheck=true; editor-helper-text contains the exact string 'Spell check uses your browser'; inserting an into the editor and clicking it shows the image-floating-toolbar with a visible delete-image-btn; clicking delete-image-btn removes the image from the editor and fires onInput so the campaign body is saved without the image. Plain-text fallback (data-testid plain-text-editor) has spellCheck={true} at L987 in RichTextEditor.jsx — confirmed by static review.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py export endpoints use Mongo projections {'_id': 0, ...} OR strip via direct dict access — no _id leakage observed. Good.

server.py convert_campaign_to_drip is non-destructive: it ONLY reads the source campaign via find_one and inserts a NEW drip doc; no update_one/delete_one is issued against db.campaigns. Verified empirically: source name/subject/body/status/from_name identical before vs after.
server.py _unique_campaign_name / _unique_drip_name correctly auto-increment '(Imported)', '(Imported 2)', '(Imported 3)' … verified end-to-end with double-import test.

server.py import_drip_campaign correctly raises 400 when zero steps are provided after normalisation — protects against orphaned drips. Wrong-type check (type=='campaign' passed to drip-import) also returns 400. Good defensive coding.
server.py import endpoints use Body(...) so JSON bodies are correctly required; auth dependency get_current_user is applied to all four new endpoints — verified anon → 401 for all 5 routes.

RichTextEditor.jsx — handleDeleteImage correctly calls onChange with the post-removal HTML and clears selectedImage state; surrounding 'before' + 'after' text preserved when Delete key removes a selected image (verified manually via JS in browser test).

RichTextEditor.jsx — htmlMode <textarea> intentionally has spellCheck={false} (raw HTML view) while the visual contentEditable and the plain-text fallback both have spellCheck={true}. Sensible defaults.
NOTE (pre-existing, NOT iteration-42): Campaign.jsx & RichTextEditor.jsx have lint complaints flagged by main agent — not introduced by this iteration; not in scope.
